title: Plug-in hybrid setup and electric range
summary: Feedback centers on appreciation for the plug-in hybrid configuration and hybrid system behavior, alongside complaints about lower-than-expected electric range and one report of awkward hybrid power delivery.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the plug-in hybrid setup for combining electric driving with conventional power and fitting owners’ needs well.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on electric range falling short of expectations and one complaint that the hybrid system transitions and battery use feel poorly managed.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention uncertainty or appreciation about choosing a plug-in hybrid and include one favorable performance statement, but the sample does not clearly separate sentiment consistently.

limitations: The sample includes many undetermined fragments, which limits how clearly sentiment can be summarized from the examples alone.
Most negative examples shown are about BEV electric range while most positive examples shown are about PHEV setup, so this topic mixes related electrification subjects across powertrain types.
Only a subset of topic fragments was provided, so uncovered aspects may be missing from this summary.
